_about: Public-domain Johann Albrecht Bengel (1687-1752), Württemberg Lutheran pietist and New Testament textual critic, for the Word Hoard: the Gnomon of the New Testament in the English translation of Clark's Foreign Theological Library (Fausset's edition, 5 vols, Edinburgh 1877), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 48 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

bengel-gnomon-1: Gnomon of the New Testament, vol. 1 (Edinburgh: T. & T. Clark, 1877)
bengel-gnomon-2: Gnomon of the New Testament, vol. 2 (Edinburgh: T. & T. Clark, 1877)
bengel-gnomon-3: Gnomon of the New Testament, vol. 3 (Edinburgh: T. & T. Clark, 1877)
bengel-gnomon-4: Gnomon of the New Testament, vol. 4 (Edinburgh: T. & T. Clark, 1877)
bengel-gnomon-5: Gnomon of the New Testament, vol. 5 (Edinburgh: T. & T. Clark, 1877)

_alternates.bengel-copies: The 1857-1859 first printing (gnomonofthenewte01benguoft etc.) and the American Lewis and Vincent translation (1860-1864, 1873)

_excluded.bengel-other: The Latin Gnomon (Tübingen 1850); Blackley's Critical English Testament (1873, an adaptation by others); Burk's Memoir of Bengel (a life by another)
